serverInfo.name: Google-AgentEditor
serverInfo.title: Google Agent Editor
serverInfo.description: Author, validate, and deploy complex Gemini Agent JSON drafts stored in the user's OneDrive.

instructions: Maintain one validated agent.json document per draft under /google-agents/{draftName}/agent.json in the user's default OneDrive. A new draft defaults id to draftName and base_agent to antigravity-preview-09-2026; existing drafts missing these values receive the same defaults in the deployment request without changing the stored draft. For a minimal web-search agent, create a uniquely named draft, enable google_search with web_search, inspect, then deploy. Omit model to use Google's default managed-agent model; gemini-2.5-flash is not supported. Inspect validates the effective deployment payload locally, not Google API acceptance. Use focused scalar, source, environment, network, function, search, and MCP-server tools rather than raw JSON parameters.
